svg.title: Knowledge from documents: the domain and its subdomains
svg.desc: The domain knowledge from documents holds four core subdomains, Ontology (BC-002), Extraction (BC-003), Knowledge graph (BC-004) and Answering (BC-005); three supporting subdomains, Sources and documents (BC-001), People and access (BC-006) and Evaluation (BC-007); and one generic subdomain, Running it (BC-008). Each subdomain maps to one bounded context.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One domain. A subdomain says what is needed; the context in the box is where the model lives.
